description: Execute an authorized handle using the inputSchema from quoapi.describe. May send messages, modify/delete data or incur charges: check pricing and obtain user approval first. For live actions, confirm=true, interactive confirmation or step-up may be required; policy can still deny execution. Optional task_id correlates workflow; provider selects an eligible upstream route; auth_mode selects a supported credential model—none bypasses access gates. Reuse idempotency_key only for the same operation with identical inputs. Returns gateway output or a structured error.

auth_mode.description: Optional upstream credential mode: QUO_MANAGED (QuoAPI-managed), CONNECTED_ACCOUNT (tenant OAuth/account), BYOK (customer key), ENTERPRISE (approved enterprise credentials). Requires configured eligibility.

capability.description: Exact, case-sensitive capability ID from quoapi.search capabilities[].handle, e.g. address.validate. Use quoapi.describe to obtain that handle's inputSchema before execution.

confirm.description: True only after the user explicitly approves this sensitive or billable live operation. Default false; server may request separate interactive confirmation or step-up and may still refuse.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-chosen idempotency key. For retry after a timeout, reuse the identical key AND unchanged capability, input and execution context. Never reuse for a new action.

input.description: JSON object whose fields and required properties match quoapi.describe inputSchema for this capability. Do not pass the entire describe response. {} is valid only for capabilities with no required input.

provider.description: Optional provider ID for a specific eligible upstream route. Omit for policy-driven routing; passing it does not create a connection, enable a disabled provider or override routing gates.

task_id.description: Optional external workflow/task correlation ID used in gateway execution metadata and audits. Not a capability handle, job-status lookup, or authorization token.

name: quoapi.execute
title: Execute a QuoAPI capability
